rationale: The IEA report directly substantiates the claim: it names lifetime extensions of existing reactors among the cheapest sources of additional low-emissions electricity and warns that without them nuclear output in advanced economies could fall by two-thirds by 2040.

sources.title: Nuclear Power and Secure Energy Transitions
sources.quoteSpan: Extending the lifetimes of existing plants is among the cheapest sources of additional low-emissions generation available to most countries.
